name: agent-datadog-operator-fargate
description: Datadog Agent via Datadog Operator (Fargate, Admission Controller sidecar)
deploy_commands: kubectl create secret generic datadog-secret --from-literal api-key={{datadog_api_key}} --from-literal token=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
kubectl create namespace fargate --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl create secret generic datadog-secret -n fargate --from-literal api-key={{datadog_api_key}} --from-literal token=$(kubectl get secret datadog-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.token}' | base64 -d)
